rows.note: Use this for “simply” meaning only or merely, and for the “alone/without addition” slice of sense 0.

example.english: I simply want a glass of water.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 jam2 bui1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this before an emphatic evaluation, meaning absolutely or positively, as in “simply wonderful.”

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gaan2 zik6 hou2 zing3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when stating something plainly, directly, or frankly.

example.english: Simply put, I don't believe him.
example.jyutping: zik6 zip3 gam2 gong2 ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for doing or presenting something in a simple, uncomplicated way, rather than for meaning only or alone.

example.english: You can simply cook this dish and it will be fine.
example.traditional: 呢道菜簡單咁煮就得喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 coi3 gaan2 daan1 gam2 zyu2 zau6 dak1 laa3
